title: The Blue Crayon with Plenty Left
youtube_title: The Blue Crayon with Plenty Left | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Saving a turn for someone else keeps the joy whole.
summary: At a picnic cloth in a calm meadow, Isla sees that a blue crayon that still had plenty left will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Isla makes a smaller, even share so Kei is included, and the baker lets the choice stand without a speech.
